
Add `{ status: "cancelled" }` when cancellation is supported. Avoid retaining the booleans alongside `status`; they would create conflicting sources of truth.

| Legacy fields | Interpretation |

| Neither flag set; no result or error | Pending |
| Done only; valid result; no error | Success |
| Failed only; valid error; no result | Failure |
| Anything else | Explicit validation failure |
